claim: At 1920x1080 the vanilla UI is not scaled: a layout is a 1280x960 canvas drawn at 1:1 pixels and docked to the screen (the battle HUD bottom-centred: canvas + (320, 120); front-end pages centred: canvas + (320, 60); the radar to the top-right corner), and UIComponent Position and Dimensions report canvas units, equal to the layout file's x, y, w, h (live width over layout width: median 1.0 over the 44 units reached in run 20261102_j10pc)
notes: measured on the shots of land_running, fe_sp_battle2 and camp_settlement; other resolutions not tried
